0a3ca051def1a5e2fc95a12094369e41.pt: Planadores em colisão que formam um dead spark coil.

4821348a728807891abf9404d88a9072.pt: Várias sínteses com planadores do oscilador figure eight.

33df19594312ae12b006e1d1556cee56.name: Fumarole synth
33df19594312ae12b006e1d1556cee56.en: Builds fumarole from gliders, both step by step (Mark Niemiec's incremental route) and all at once (Stephen Silver's direct route).
33df19594312ae12b006e1d1556cee56.pt: Constrói o fumarole com planadores, tanto por etapas (síntese incremental de Mark Niemiec) quanto de uma vez (síntese direta de Stephen Silver).

261a0dc69b1d64a50841170c50674de8.name: Gray counter synth
261a0dc69b1d64a50841170c50674de8.en: Colliding gliders that build a Gray counter.
261a0dc69b1d64a50841170c50674de8.pt: Planadores em colisão que constroem um Gray counter.

3e384e4329db41664e82ca7140f3b320.name: Heavyweight spaceship synth

3e384e4329db41664e82ca7140f3b320.pt: Planadores colidem para criar uma nave pesada (HWSS).

08df1906ff97535e34d03e29d89af8cf.pt: Várias formas de construir o hook with tail com planadores.

118a4c7728ce73926188598c7004d72b.pt: Constrói o integral with tub com quatro planadores; há outras sínteses no banco de dados de Mark Niemiec.

05f2446050c221c97356ea7534d81840.pt: Dezoito planadores colidem para construir o Karel's p15.

032e902e4dd094a63b288acb53ce9077.pt: Constrói a long^3 snake (também chamada extra long snake) com planadores.

425b857c0f4b471c8bd9826a19e74cf2.pt: Planadores em colisão que constroem um middleweight emulator.

10b0141aaa55330230063f71efd769a5.name: Mold on pentadecathlon synth
10b0141aaa55330230063f71efd769a5.en: Eight gliders collide to build mold on pentadecathlon.
10b0141aaa55330230063f71efd769a5.pt: Oito planadores colidem para construir o mold on pentadecathlon.

29588cb9913519ac570dd7d4cf6c0e43.name: Octagon 4 synth
29588cb9913519ac570dd7d4cf6c0e43.en: Thirty-four gliders collide to build Octagon 4.
29588cb9913519ac570dd7d4cf6c0e43.pt: Trinta e quatro planadores colidem para construir o Octagon 4.

0c9cba4c34f40a3bb38e0a07a9badc88.name: p40bheptominoshuttle synth
0c9cba4c34f40a3bb38e0a07a9badc88.en: Twenty-nine gliders collide to build the p40 B-heptomino shuttle.
0c9cba4c34f40a3bb38e0a07a9badc88.pt: Vinte e nove planadores colidem para construir o p40 B-heptomino shuttle.

56a25d825a6d626a805d286b01bad372.name: p856glidergun synth
56a25d825a6d626a805d286b01bad372.en: Colliding gliders that construct a period-856 glider gun.
56a25d825a6d626a805d286b01bad372.pt: Planadores em colisão que constroem um canhão de planadores de período 856.

0875a7bb25fbb5ed24612fea57823aea.name: pentoad1h2 synth
0875a7bb25fbb5ed24612fea57823aea.en: Nineteen gliders collide to build pentoad 1H2.
0875a7bb25fbb5ed24612fea57823aea.pt: Dezenove planadores colidem para construir o pentoad 1H2.

f97e468bc84d3e002b45d4aac697c076.name: pipsquirter1 synth
f97e468bc84d3e002b45d4aac697c076.pt: Planadores em colisão que constroem o pipsquirter 1.

02e55f8039b3574154b32843252dcbba.name: Puffer 2 synth
02e55f8039b3574154b32843252dcbba.pt: Planadores em colisão que constroem o puffer 2.

474ad41dbc8b3802a82c06e3be621992.name: Queen bee shuttle synth
474ad41dbc8b3802a82c06e3be621992.en: Colliding gliders that build the queen bee shuttle.
474ad41dbc8b3802a82c06e3be621992.pt: Planadores em colisão que constroem o queen bee shuttle.

0570e8f3c29578fc1fb4b90bb63a7964.name: Scorpion synth
0570e8f3c29578fc1fb4b90bb63a7964.en: Several ways to build the scorpion still life from gliders.
0570e8f3c29578fc1fb4b90bb63a7964.pt: Várias formas de construir a vida estática scorpion com planadores.

0c1d4801184609a68a977e5468b56648.name: Ship-tie synth
0c1d4801184609a68a977e5468b56648.en: Several ways to build a ship-tie from gliders.
0c1d4801184609a68a977e5468b56648.pt: Várias formas de construir um ship-tie com planadores.

192d166dacbb03a858b51cddc7855b7b.name: Small lake synth
192d166dacbb03a858b51cddc7855b7b.en: Several ways to build small lake from gliders.
192d166dacbb03a858b51cddc7855b7b.pt: Várias formas de construir o small lake com planadores.

03858832b5bc370b9cf1424e230dec19.name: Snakewithfeather synth
03858832b5bc370b9cf1424e230dec19.en: Builds snake with feather from five gliders.
03858832b5bc370b9cf1424e230dec19.pt: Constrói o snake with feather com cinco planadores.

332bc61b16f9a4d9cd4b352908f11b55.name: Symmetricscorpion synth
332bc61b16f9a4d9cd4b352908f11b55.en: Four gliders collide to build the symmetric scorpion.
332bc61b16f9a4d9cd4b352908f11b55.pt: Quatro planadores colidem para construir o symmetric scorpion.

4613a99288b0bc4dbbdabff6ea923b9c.name: tnosedp4 synth
4613a99288b0bc4dbbdabff6ea923b9c.en: Fifty-six gliders collide to build T-nosed p4.
4613a99288b0bc4dbbdabff6ea923b9c.pt: Cinquenta e seis planadores colidem para construir o T-nosed p4.

0ad935745373b28f81d78a104bf0441f.name: Trans-block and long hook eating tub synth
0ad935745373b28f81d78a104bf0441f.en: Twelve gliders collide to build it: a trans block plus a long hook eating a tub.
0ad935745373b28f81d78a104bf0441f.pt: Doze planadores colidem para construir o Trans-block and long hook eating tub.

167c68c0a2e71ed58b18814b72b4726d.name: Tricetongs synth
167c68c0a2e71ed58b18814b72b4726d.en: Ten gliders collide to build trice tongs.
167c68c0a2e71ed58b18814b72b4726d.pt: Dez planadores colidem para construir o trice tongs.

0903de9ab5431ce57a64e1bcca4c543b.name: Twelveloop synth
0903de9ab5431ce57a64e1bcca4c543b.en: Four gliders collide to build twelve loop.
0903de9ab5431ce57a64e1bcca4c543b.pt: Quatro planadores colidem para construir o twelve loop.

2f3b647fa16562cdde2af6b212a98fed.name: Twocisgriddleswtwotubs synth
2f3b647fa16562cdde2af6b212a98fed.en: Ten gliders collide to build a pair of cis griddles with two tubs.
2f3b647fa16562cdde2af6b212a98fed.pt: Dez planadores colidem para construir dois griddles em cis com duas tubs.

20ca3467528c307654fb08ede6e17669.name: Verylongcanoe synth
20ca3467528c307654fb08ede6e17669.en: Several ways to build the very long canoe (also called long long canoe) from gliders.
20ca3467528c307654fb08ede6e17669.pt: Várias formas de construir o very long canoe (ou long long canoe) com planadores.

126a8a4f0d9594922e5755df26858a28.name: x66 synth
126a8a4f0d9594922e5755df26858a28.en: Builds x66 from 13 gliders, and x66-half attached to an HWSS from 9; both syntheses were derived from an apgsearch soup.
126a8a4f0d9594922e5755df26858a28.pt: Constrói o x66 com 13 planadores, e o x66-half preso a uma nave pesada com 9; as duas sínteses vieram de uma sopa do apgsearch.

70abc44acaca8486fab8f1f202d60a0b.name: Catacryst
70abc44acaca8486fab8f1f202d60a0b.en: Its population grows quadratically over time.
70abc44acaca8486fab8f1f202d60a0b.pt: Sua população cresce de forma quadrática com o tempo.

ef708e8a1b41a2c16c5d94956ce34488.name: Infinite glider hotel
ef708e8a1b41a2c16c5d94956ce34488.en: As the two Cordership pairs recede, the space between them keeps widening and can hold an ever larger number of bouncing gliders, hence the 'infinite hotel'.
ef708e8a1b41a2c16c5d94956ce34488.pt: Conforme dois pares de Corderships se afastam, o espaço entre eles aumenta e comporta um número cada vez maior de planadores quicando; daí o 'hotel infinito'.

ac1db14f93badb3d1b0c0cd0e2c70563.name: Mosquito 2
ac1db14f93badb3d1b0c0cd0e2c70563.en: Its population grows quadratically over time.
ac1db14f93badb3d1b0c0cd0e2c70563.pt: Sua população cresce de forma quadrática com o tempo.

9a1fb7675f0e7756a0717bfcfacda7cc.name: p5760 unit Life cell
9a1fb7675f0e7756a0717bfcfacda7cc.en: The first unit Life cell ever discovered; as its name shows, it has period 5760.
9a1fb7675f0e7756a0717bfcfacda7cc.pt: A primeira unit Life cell descoberta; como indica o nome, tem período 5760.

03a35fe7827c876619db484aaf0bc5be.name: Ruler
03a35fe7827c876619db484aaf0bc5be.en: Sends out westbound groups of LWSSs with fixed gaps; group sizes follow the ruler sequence, which starts 1, 2, 1, 3, 1... Built by Dean Hickerson.
03a35fe7827c876619db484aaf0bc5be.pt: Emite grupos de naves leves rumo ao oeste, com intervalos fixos; o tamanho dos grupos segue a sequência da régua (1, 2, 1, 3, 1...). Construído por Dean Hickerson.

f4b8832002b54917a01b944b56ae97f3.name: Twin prime calculator
f4b8832002b54917a01b944b56ae97f3.en: Emits a stream of LWSSs that encodes the twin prime numbers.
f4b8832002b54917a01b944b56ae97f3.pt: Emite um fluxo de naves leves que representa os números primos gêmeos.

89a727280676bfa4f31919e92197e504.name: Butterfly
89a727280676bfa4f31919e92197e504.en: After 33 generations it settles into a pair of beehives, a formation that shares the name. In teardrop the two beehives end up five cells closer.
89a727280676bfa4f31919e92197e504.pt: Após 33 gerações vira um par de colmeias, formação que leva o mesmo nome. No teardrop, as duas colmeias ficam cinco células mais próximas.

2eb89f3df295e6bdc7a438821e2c79d1.name: Garden of Eden 2
2eb89f3df295e6bdc7a438821e2c79d1.en: An orphan as well as a Garden of Eden, so no pattern can evolve into it. No smaller example was known when it was found.
2eb89f3df295e6bdc7a438821e2c79d1.pt: Órfão e também Jardim do Éden: nenhum padrão pode evoluir até ele. Quando foi encontrado, não se conhecia exemplo menor.

655e40674037415759f6b567e9fd861d.name: Handshake
655e40674037415759f6b567e9fd861d.en: Lumps of muck was once called this at MIT, after this very shape, which the stairstep hexomino reaches in two generations.
655e40674037415759f6b567e9fd861d.pt: No MIT, o lumps of muck era chamado assim, por causa desta forma, que o stairstep hexomino atinge em duas gerações.

23b57d1b56c3e0201bc896ade062977b.name: Line-mending reaction
23b57d1b56c3e0201bc896ade062977b.en: Spaceships flanking an infinite diagonal line, timed to each other, fill in a sealed break so the line is whole again, e.g. after a line-cutting reaction.
23b57d1b56c3e0201bc896ade062977b.pt: Naves posicionadas dos dois lados de uma linha diagonal infinita, sincronizadas entre si, preenchem uma brecha selada e deixam a linha inteira de novo, por exemplo após uma reação de corte de linha.

06a04c54c866cc89d6eab8ed79fcaca6.name: One-sided spaceship synthesis
06a04c54c866cc89d6eab8ed79fcaca6.en: An LWSS assembled entirely by gliders coming in from one side of its lane. The 17c/45 Caterpillar depends on this kind of one-sided recipe throughout.
06a04c54c866cc89d6eab8ed79fcaca6.pt: Uma nave leve montada só com planadores vindos de um lado da sua rota. O Caterpillar 17c/45 depende desse tipo de receita unilateral em toda a sua estrutura.

05a0e63fa5d4f2bec45b9d9f9807a936.name: Pre-pulsar
05a0e63fa5d4f2bec45b9d9f9807a936.en: A frequent source of pulsars: it doubles itself in 15 generations, but the two copies then interfere, so it is no true replicator. Tubs that eat half of it yield the p30 Eureka.
05a0e63fa5d4f2bec45b9d9f9807a936.pt: Origem frequente de pulsares: duplica-se em 15 gerações, mas as duas cópias então interferem uma na outra, por isso não é um replicador de verdade. Tubs que comem metade dele geram o Eureka, de período 30.

3ffdf6f08cb74e3e4e0e65f3f25782c4.name: Side
3ffdf6f08cb74e3e4e0e65f3f25782c4.en: It is one half of a sidewalk, and by itself it will not stay still: an induction coil has to hold it in place.
3ffdf6f08cb74e3e4e0e65f3f25782c4.pt: É uma das metades de um sidewalk e, sozinha, não fica parada: precisa de uma bobina de indução para mantê-la no lugar.

21ea48209eed1201200bfc376207b9a1.name: Table
21ea48209eed1201200bfc376207b9a1.en: A simple induction coil. Left on its own, it dies out after 15 generations.
21ea48209eed1201200bfc376207b9a1.pt: Uma bobina de indução simples. Sozinha, desaparece após 15 gerações.

04e181a59a05d3cc911356ca31ecc267.name: Traffic lights extruder
04e181a59a05d3cc911356ca31ecc267.en: Shows the reaction behind Jason Summers' extruder, which slowly grows a chain of traffic lights: a new light born on the left eventually nudges the rightmost one outward.
04e181a59a05d3cc911356ca31ecc267.pt: Mostra a reação por trás do extrusor de Jason Summers, que faz crescer devagar uma cadeia de traffic lights: um novo traffic light nasce à esquerda e acaba empurrando o último da direita para fora.

28b1b7bc421a445aec84b106ac89dc25.name: Vspark
28b1b7bc421a445aec84b106ac89dc25.en: The pentadecathlon is the classic source of this small three-cell spark, which can convert a block, or a pre-block, into a glider.
28b1b7bc421a445aec84b106ac89dc25.pt: O pentadecathlon é a fonte clássica desta pequena faísca de três células, capaz de converter um bloco, ou um pré-bloco, em planador.
